status.evidence: According to company listings and Tracxn profile data, Foretrack is an active vehicle and asset tracking brand owned and operated by Foresolutions Limited, which is based in Ringwood, United Kingdom.

claims.claim: PW Gates deployed Foretrack trailer tracking to improve vehicle visibility, utilization, and capacity planning, achieving a reported £25k annual direct cost saving and an approximate 23× first-year return on investment according to a Foresolutions case study.

Total Cleaning Company South implemented the Foretrack GPS system across its fleet of 12 vehicles, enabling dispatchers to track cleaning technicians live, monitor average speeds or journey times, and optimize routing to avoid traffic as reported by Van Fleet World.

Foresolutions Limited establishes in its official terms and conditions that the Foretrack Connect asset tracking platform governs data handling under the UK GDPR as defined by the Data Protection Act 2018 (Foresolutions Terms and Conditions).

Haulage and logistics provider PW Gates deployed the Foretrack trailer tracking platform across approximately 95% of its fleet to improve asset visibility and routing efficiency, as reported in a case study by Foresolutions.

Energy solutions provider Empower Energy deployed 20 advanced telematics vehicle camera systems integrated with the Foretrack Connect cloud management software to manage its mobile field engineers, as detailed by Foresolutions.
The company reports an operational case study involving its client PW Gates, which deployed Foretrack's trailer tracking solution to achieve an estimated £25,000 in annual direct cost savings.

Foresolutions (the provider of Foretrack) actively runs a reseller and dealer program, offering commercial packages, sales training, and technical support to partners distributing its commercial vehicle tracking product.

The company maintains hardware and technology integration partnerships with manufacturers such as Teltonika, Digital Matter, Howen, Parksafe Group, Caltta, Hytera, Motorola Solutions, and Zello to deliver its integrated tracking solutions.

Foresolutions Limited reports its company headquarters at a single office facility located at Unit 5C, GP Centre, Yeoman Road in Ringwood, Hampshire, United Kingdom, according to official company corporate records.
